verdict.rationale: Twenty documents native dashboards with configurable charts, data sources, filters, aggregation and grouping, explicitly for pipeline metrics, team performance and revenue trends, so the core is delivered in-product without exporting. Activity and conversion reporting are not specifically documented, and no hands-on or community evidence corroborates the dashboards. missing for 10: explicit activity reporting (emails/meetings/tasks), conversion or funnel-rate reporting, independent corroboration of dashboard depth.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Track pipeline metrics, team performance, and business KPIs with configurable charts and filters.
You can configure: Chart type... Data source... Filters... Aggregation... Grouping
Dashboards give you real-time visibility into your business metrics — pipeline health, team performance, revenue trends, and anything else you want to track.
